classification.difficultyReason: Combine three distances and durations, convert units, then calculate average speed over the event.

content.prompt: A standard (or Olympic) triathlon race involves 1500 m of swimming, followed by a 40-km bike ride, and finally a 10-km run. If a competitor took 20 minutes for the swim, 55 minutes for the ride and 35 minutes for the run, what was her average speed throughout the event?

answer.short:
$28\frac{1}{11}\text{ km/h}$

Divide the total distance by the total time in hours.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Total distance}&=\frac{1500}{1000}+40+10\\\text{Total distance}&=51.5\text{ km}\\\text{Total time}&=20+55+35\\\text{Total time}&=110\text{ min}\\\text{Total time}&=\frac{110}{60}\text{ h}\\\text{Total time}&=\frac{11}{6}\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=51.5\div\frac{11}{6}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{309}{11}\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&=28\frac{1}{11}\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$
